meta.name: add-codex
meta.description: Use Codex (OpenAI's codex app-server) as a full agent provider — planning, tool orchestration, MCP tools, server-side history, session resume — alongside or instead of Claude. ChatGPT subscription or OpenAI API key, vault-only via OneCLI. Per-group via `ncl groups config update --provider codex`. Distinct from using OpenAI as an MCP tool (where Claude remains the planner).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用 Codex 替代或配合 Claude 作为智能体规划器
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Claude 之外使用 Codex 作为智能体核心规划器
copy.tagline_en: Use Codex as a full agent provider alongside or instead of Claude
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to use Codex as the primary agent planner instead of or alongside Claude

howto.what: 把 Codex 装成 NanoClaw 的另一种代理后端。装好后,你可以把某个组切到 Codex 上跑,而不是只用 Claude;它会自动完成文件复制、改配置、构建和登录认证。
howto.when: 当你明确要求安装 Codex 提供者,或要求把某个组切换为 Codex 后端时触发。

say.text: 帮我安装 Codex 提供者。
say.note: 它会执行安装流程并引导你登录认证。

say.text: 把组 <组名> 切换到 Codex。
say.note: 它会运行 ncl groups config 更新该组后端。
它会询问是否修改默认设置,改完重启服务。

howto.what_en: Installs Codex as an alternative agent backend for NanoClaw. Once installed, you can switch a group to run on Codex instead of Claude; it handles copying files, updating config, building, and auth automatically.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you explicitly ask to install the Codex provider, or to switch a group to the Codex backend.

say_en.note: It runs the install flow and guides you through auth.
It runs ncl groups config to update the group's backend.

say_en.text: Set the default agent to Codex.
say_en.note: It asks before changing the default and restarts the service.
